f.title: MAH is legally responsible for drug safety, efficacy and quality across the lifecycle
f.statement: Drug MAHs shall be legally responsible for drug safety, efficacy and quality management throughout drug research and development, manufacturing, distribution and use.
f.applicability: China; English translation published by NMPA (Chinese text prevails). Captured text is page 1 of 3 (Articles 1-50 only). In force from 1 December 2019.

f.title: Sponsor must adjust, suspend or stop a trial and report when safety issues arise
f.statement: Where safety issues or other risks are discovered during a drug clinical trial, the sponsor shall promptly adjust the clinical trial protocol, suspend or terminate the trial, and report to the drug regulatory department under the State Council. If necessary, that department may order the sponsor to adjust the protocol or to suspend or end the trial.
f.applicability: China; English translation published by NMPA (Chinese text prevails). Captured text is page 1 of 3 (Articles 1-50 only). In force from 1 December 2019.

f.title: MAH is responsible for post-marketing studies and ADR monitoring, reporting and handling
f.statement: MAHs shall, in accordance with this Law, be responsible for non-clinical studies, clinical trials, manufacture and distribution, post-marketing studies, and monitoring, reporting and handling of adverse drug reactions.
f.applicability: China; English translation published by NMPA (Chinese text prevails). Captured text is page 1 of 3 (Articles 1-50 only). In force from 1 December 2019.

f.statement: MAHs shall establish an annual reporting system and report information including drug manufacturing and distribution, post-marketing studies and risk management to the provincial drug regulatory departments in accordance with regulations.

f.title: Overseas MAH must designate a domestic legal entity to fulfil MAH obligations
f.statement: Where the MAH is an overseas enterprise, an enterprise legal person in China shall be designated to fulfil the MAH obligations and assume joint liability with the MAH.
f.applicability: China; English translation published by NMPA (Chinese text prevails). Captured text is page 1 of 3 (Articles 1-50 only). In force from 1 December 2019.

f.title: Decoction-piece manufacturers must fulfil MAH obligations
f.statement: Manufacturers of decoction pieces of Chinese medicine shall fulfil the relevant obligations of an MAH, implement whole-chain management of the manufacture and distribution of decoction pieces, and establish a traceability system to ensure their safety, efficacy and traceability.

f.title: Transferee of a marketing authorization must have risk control capacity and fulfil MAH obligations
f.statement: An MAH may transfer its drug marketing authorization upon approval; the transferee shall be capable of quality management, risk control and compensation for liability, and shall fulfil the obligations of the MAH.
f.applicability: China; English translation published by NMPA (Chinese text prevails). Captured text is page 1 of 3 (Articles 1-50 only). In force from 1 December 2019.

f.title: State contraindications, adverse drug reactions and precautions on label and package insert
f.statement: The label or package insert shall indicate, among other particulars (adopted name, ingredients and strength, MAH and manufacturer name and address, approval number, batch number, production and expiry dates), the indications or functions, dosage and administration, contraindications, adverse drug reactions and precautions.
